fields.subject: Interim arrangements for the office of the Chief Executive Officer
fields.body: The Chief Executive Officer is unavailable for an indefinite period. The board met in special session and acted under the bylaws. Day-to-day operations continue under the arrangements below. The board will tell employees and investors through the usual channels after counsel has reviewed the disclosure questions.
fields.interimHolder: Priya Nandakumar, Lead Independent Director, as interim Chief Executive Officer
fields.effective: Immediately, until the board decides otherwise

fields.subject: Delegation of authority while the CEO office is vacant
fields.body: Authority is delegated as follows until the board decides otherwise.

matrix.limit: Notify board chair within one hour
